title: HumanPay
tagline: HumanPay is a marketplace for API, AI agents, and applications in pay-as-you-go format
description:
So human pay does allow users to Use on paid APIs, AI agents, and applications for a short period of time in the best form of manner, let's say like one API call at a time.
A verified human user can use this platform to serve various purposes as per his need. The platform verifies that you are a human, which enables that the APIs are not abused, and only the bot's activity is restricted. This allows you to have a minimal payment that is required to use APIs which are behind the Paywall. 
With Human Pay, a person or verified human being verified with the World ID can use this any of the offerings for the least price possible. So when the usage of something is limited, the user doesn't have to pay a complete subscription fee and buy it for a lot of time. Instead, this allows you to use it for the shortest period of time, which is always beneficial for a user.
how_its_made:
This is a mini app created on World App, using mostly React and Coinbase CDP APIs, and also the x402 infrastructure provided by Coinbase. 
The World Coin is used to verify that only a verified human is able to access these APIs. So once the human has verified, he will get an API key that he can use across various platforms to accomplish the tasks. Similarly, the API key would also work as an orchestrator to access various other APIs, or like AI agents and applications as well.
